controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-postgresql.log-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T20:02:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T21:02:30.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(message LIKE "*password authentication failed*", "auth_failed",
                         message LIKE "*does not exist*", "role_not_exist",
                         "other")
| STATS cnt = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event_type, message, user.name
| SORT event_type, cnt DESC, message
| LIMIT 50
